hypothesis: A causal binary-carry tree that recursively summarizes decoded 128-byte WRT patches with one shared merge cell exposes at least 3000 gross bytes per raw million of sealed endpoint428 residual headroom and strictly beats a parameter-matched flat recurrent state and page-rotated hierarchy states.
interfaces_exposed: N2 recursively merges decoded byte summaries through one weight-shared binary-carry tree while leaving Gamma P1 and truth updates unchanged.
kill_condition: On any target-scale, control, package, determinism, or reconstruction miss, retire this exact 128-byte binary-carry construction without patch-size, level, width, optimizer, epoch, aggregation, quantization, or rotation sweeps. Do not add surprise memory to rescue a hierarchy miss.
promotion_condition: At exact opening 1M, development and selection gains are positive, sealed gross gain is at least 3000 B/M, sealed package-adjusted gain is at least 2100 B/M, N2 beats matched N1 and rotated NS, repeated model/P1/payload/history hashes are identical, and parent payload, arithmetic decode, WRT reconstruction, and official raw inverse are exact. A pass authorizes one frozen distant reset replay only.
retired_neighborhoods: Unlike CHIRON/JANUS flat patch GRUs and the retired direct power-of-two lag model, N2 never reads fixed lag coordinates and represents the prefix through recursive equal-span merges with shared weights.
title: MOBIUS-2 NOEMA shared-cell binary-carry hierarchy headroom
